cross_course_judgments.judgment: Source-reported observations, derived transforms, mechanisms and planned experiments remain separately typed.
ICRS ordered columns, intentional negative determinant, physical origin and half-open ownership remain distinct from synthetic positive-determinant examples and galaxy reconstruction geometry.
Direct Gram metric, inverse Gram metric, reciprocal basis, G_phase, G_eff and source-local Q symbols are not silently identified.
Ownership uses floor(q+1/2) with u=q-z; carry uses ceil(t-1/2) with epsilon=Q-t. The same half-open residual interval does not make these the same tie convention.
Ternary address count 27^d3 is separate from 27*8^n2 dyadic subcells and (3*2^n2+1)^3 geometric vertices.

Finite fixed-block linear, unital, idempotent averaging and its subalgebra/bimodule properties support the stated product identity. Q=I-E alone is not promoted to a sufficient hypothesis; infinite product domains remain unsupplied.
Area ratios and positive fixed-angle scaling are conditional geometric statements, not derived force laws or complete spatial reconstruction from area ratios alone.
Mode eigenvalue signs, 13/14 node chi counts, 14/13 antipodal function dimensions and detector parity operators have separate definitions.

Typed source action, six determinant-line factors and every-admitted-sector requirement are not replaced by scalar synthetic products. Missing operators, topology, trivializations, coefficients and normalization remain visible. The QPC residual is not declared zero by an invented precision rule.
Rank 48 is conditional on a nonzero self-adjoint rank-one history projector. Equal family restrictions do not establish physical occupation or orthogonality of distinct history projectors.
